details: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has severed economic ties with Iran, a significant geopolitical development that caused West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil prices to jump over 2%. This action adds to existing tensions in the Middle East and concerns about energy supply. Higher oil prices can contribute to inflation and impact global economic stability.
title: UAE Cuts Economic Ties with Iran, Bolstering Oil Prices

details: Bitcoin surged by 6.9% to over US$77,675.94, reaching its highest level since May, driven by two key factors. The US Treasury's surprise move to double its sovereign bond buybacks aimed at lowering long-term borrowing costs, increasing investor appetite for riskier assets. Additionally, President Donald Trump urged lawmakers to pass the stalled Clarity Act to spur cryptocurrency use, fueling optimism for regulatory clarity and institutional participation.
title: Bitcoin Rallies Amid US Treasury Action and Trump's Crypto Push

details: On August 22, the cryptocurrency market suffered its largest flash crash since October 2025, with $108 billion wiped from the total market cap in just six minutes. This led to $1.71 billion in liquidations across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP, hitting leveraged long positions hardest. Bitcoin fell to approximately $76,500, Ethereum to $2,426, and XRP dropped around 12%. This abrupt reversal highlights the fragility of recent rallies driven by political narratives.
title: Crypto Market Flash Crash Wipes Out $1.7 Billion in Liquidations

details: On August 20, the Moscow Exchange Index (IMOEX) retreated by approximately 2.3–2.4% due to deteriorating expectations regarding a peaceful settlement of the Ukrainian conflict. Uncertainty surrounding the confirmed dates for US negotiators to visit Russia was a primary trigger, leading market participants to reduce risk exposure as hopes for diplomatic progress waned.
title: Russian Stocks Fall on Ukraine Conflict Peace Deal Uncertainty
